term: 「长城是太空肉眼可见的唯一人造建筑」
termEn: "The Great Wall Is the Only Human Work Visible from Space"
myth: 流传版本称从月球或太空用肉眼就能看到长城，仿佛它是大地上唯一的人造印记。
mythEn: The claim says the Wall can be seen from the Moon or from orbit with the naked eye, as if it were the only human mark on the land.
truth: 低轨道肉眼确实能看到一些人造物（城市、农田、运河），但长城平均宽仅数米、色泽近于山体，肉眼辨认几乎不可能，「唯一」更无从谈起。
truthEn: From low orbit people do spot human features — cities, fields, canals — but the Wall averages only a few meters wide and matches its hillsides; spotting it bare-eyed is close to impossible, and 'the only one' has no basis.
detail: 说法源于航天时代之前的想象：早在1909年就有人宣称「从火星能看到长城」。多位航天员在轨用镜头拍摄长城区域亦难找到它；肉眼真正可见的是城市灯光、大型水库与田块。
detailEn: The idea pre-dates spaceflight — as early as 1909 voices claimed it visible even from Mars. Astronauts photographing the Wall's region from orbit struggle to pick it out; what the naked eye truly catches are city lights, reservoirs and farmland.

term: 「尼罗河一定是世界第一长河」
termEn: "The Nile Is Certainly the World's Longest River"
myth: 教科书常把尼罗河列为第一、亚马逊河第二，似乎名次没有争议。
mythEn: Textbooks often rank the Nile first and the Amazon second, as though the order were settled.
truth: 两河在「最长」之争上互有胜负：亚马逊河流量与流域面积稳居第一，长度则取决于源头如何认定，不同测量各称胜出。
truthEn: The two rivals trade places: the Amazon's discharge and basin are beyond challenge, while its length — and the Nile's — depends on where you dare to set the source.
detail: 以尼罗河最南支流为源约6650公里；若把亚马逊正源推到秘鲁南部深入安第斯山，一些测量给出6800公里以上。21世纪多次科考各自宣称本方胜出，但学界未有一致结论——名次是约定而非定理。
detailEn: Start the Nile at its remotest southern tributary and it runs about 6,650 km; push the Amazon's source deep into southern Peru and some surveys exceed 6,800 km. Expeditions in the 2000s claimed victory each way; the ranking is convention, not theorem.

termEn: "Everest Is the Tallest Mountain by Every Measure"
myth: 珠峰是无可争议的「世界最高山」。
mythEn: Everest is the undisputed tallest mountain on Earth.
truth: 珠峰只赢在「海拔」这一个口径：从山脚算起，夏威夷的盾状火山高出海面之下合超万米；离地心最远的高峰是厄瓜多尔的赤道火山。
truthEn: Everest wins only the sea-level measure. Measured from its base, a shield volcano in Hawaii climbs over 10 km; the point farthest from Earth's center is an equatorial peak in Ecuador.
detail: 海拔是以大地水准面为基准的「水平线」，而赤道因自转隆起、半径比两极大约21公里：赤道峰顶因此在地心距离口径上击败珠峰；海底基准则让冒纳开亚反超。「最高」要先问「从哪儿量到哪儿」。
detailEn: Sea level is a drawn baseline, and the equatorial bulge makes Earth's radius some 21 km larger there than at the poles — so an equatorial summit beats Everest on the center-to-surface measure; on the seafloor-base measure, Mauna Kea climbs past both. 'Tallest' must first answer: measured from where to where?

myth: 热带横贯赤道两侧，终年烈日，是地球上最热的地方。
mythEn: The tropics straddle the equator under endless sun, so they must be the hottest places on Earth.
truth: 最热纪录集中在副热带荒漠；赤道附近的高原山地却常年凉爽——海拔每升百米约降温0.6℃，足以抵消低纬的骄阳。
truthEn: Heat records belong to the subtropical deserts; upland towns near the equator stay cool year-round — altitude drops about 0.6°C per 100 m, canceling the low-latitude sun.
detail: 安第斯山麓的赤道城市常年二旬上下、夜间需添衣；世界热极却在北非与西亚的干漠——气流干燥、辐射强、无水体调节。同一纬度带上，决定冷暖的不是太阳，而是海拔与海陆。
detailEn: Equatorial Andean towns hold near 20°C by day and need blankets at night, while the world's heat poles sit in the dry deserts of North Africa and West Asia — arid air, hard radiation, no water to moderate. Across one latitude band, altitude and sea-land layout, not sunlight, set the thermometer.

termEn: "The Arctic and Antarctic Are Equally Cold"
myth: 同为高纬极地、同有半年极夜，冷暖程度应当差不多。
mythEn: Both are polar, both know half-year nights, so their cold should match.
truth: 南极远比北极寒冷：南极内陆录得地球最低天然温度约零下89℃，北极纪录约零下69℃；南极也是平均海拔最高的大陆。
truthEn: Antarctica is far colder than the Arctic: its interior holds the natural low near −89°C against the Arctic's near −69°C — and Antarctica is also the highest continent on average.
detail: 差在三点：南极是覆冰的高原大陆，陆地比海水降温快；南极绕极流隔断了与低纬的热量交换；北极则是被大陆环绕的冰洋，北大西洋暖流冬日仍能侵入。同纬度带，海陆配置翻转了常识。
detailEn: Three reasons stack up: Antarctica is an ice-capped high continent and land chills faster than sea; the circumpolar current cuts off heat from lower latitudes; the Arctic is an ocean ringed by continents, which winter warm water from the North Atlantic still intrudes upon. Same latitude band, reversed geography.

termEn: "Lightning Never Strikes the Same Place Twice"
myth: 闪电随机选址，同一地点再被击中的可能性很小。
mythEn: Lightning picks targets at random, so a spot struck once is unlikely to be hit again.
truth: 闪电有明显偏好：高尖、导电之物反复被击是常态，摩天大楼一遭雷劫数十次不足为奇。
truthEn: Lightning has favorites: tall, pointy, conductive things get struck again and again — a skyscraper may take dozens of strikes in a year.
detail: 先导梯级下行，一旦电离通道建立，后续放电就沿旧路再来一遍——击中一次，更易再被击中。避雷设计正是以「重复击中」为前提。
detailEn: A stepped leader probes downward; once an ionized channel exists, later discharges reuse it — being struck once makes a second strike likelier. Lightning-rod engineering assumes exactly this repetition.

termEn: "Seasons Come from Earth's Distance to the Sun"
myth: 夏天是地球靠近太阳，冬天是远离。
mythEn: Summer means Earth nearer the Sun, winter means farther away.
truth: 四季源于黄赤交角（约23.4°）：半球倾向太阳时正午更高、白昼更长即为夏；地球1月初过近日点，恰是北半球隆冬。
truthEn: Seasons come from the 23.4° axial tilt: a hemisphere leans sunward, the noon runs higher and the days longer — and Earth reaches perihelion in early January, dead of the northern winter.
detail: 近日比远日仅近约3.1%，全球获得的太阳辐射变化不过7%，解释不了冬夏反差；而太阳高度与昼夜长短此消彼长，让南北半球季节精确相反——「距离说」过不了半球翻转这道题。
detailEn: Perihelion tightens the distance by only about 3.1%, shifting the planet's solar intake by some 7% — nowhere near enough for winter-versus-summer. Sun angle and day length, however, flip between hemispheres with clockwork precision, which the distance story can never explain.

myth: 地球像教学用地球仪一样是个标准圆球。
mythEn: Earth is a standard ball, like the classroom globe.
truth: 地球是两极稍扁、赤道略鼓的椭球，赤道与极直径差约43公里；而由平均海平面延展开的「大地水准面」，还因重力起伏上下鼓落数十米。
truthEn: Earth is an oblate spheroid — flattened at the poles, bulging at the equator by some 43 km of diameter — and its geoid, the mean-sea-level surface extended inland, heaves tens of meters on gravity's unevenness.
detail: 十七世纪末牛顿按旋转理论预言了扁球，随后赴拉普兰与秘鲁的大地测量证实；现代卫星测定扁率约1/298.257。地球仪把扁率与水准面起伏都抹平了——它是模型，不是比例。
detailEn: Newton predicted the flattening from rotation theory in the 1690s; geodesic expeditions to Lapland and Peru confirmed it, and satellites now fix the flattening near 1/298.257. The classroom globe smooths both away — it is a model, not a scale.

myth: 荒漠就是波涛起伏的金色沙海。
mythEn: A desert is an ocean of rolling golden dunes.
truth: 沙丘荒漠只占全球荒漠的小部分；多数荒漠是裸岩、砾石（戈壁）与盐碱地，「沙海」反倒是少数派。
truthEn: Dune fields make up only a minority of the world's deserts; most are bare bedrock, gravel pavements — the reg of the Gobi — and salt flats.
detail: 卫星统计显示流动沙丘约占荒漠的两成上下：撒哈拉的岩漠与砾漠面积远超沙海，戈壁多以风吹不走、只剩砾石被面的岩块覆盖层为主。沙海是影像的想象，不是地貌的底图。
detailEn: Satellite tallies put shifting dunes at around a fifth of desert area: the Sahara's rocky and gravel deserts dwarf its sand seas, and the Gobi is chiefly a pavement of lag stones the wind could not lift. The sea of sand is a camera's idea, not the geomorphic base map.

term: 「墨卡托投影画出了国家的真实大小」
termEn: "Mercator Maps Show Countries at Their True Size"
myth: 世界地图上的大小就是各国的实际比例。
mythEn: The world map you hang shows each country at its real relative size.
truth: 墨卡托投影保角不保面积：纬度越高等距线被拉得越开，格陵兰看着与非洲相当，实际仅约十四分之一。
truthEn: Mercator preserves angles, not area: spacing between parallels stretches with latitude, so Greenland looms as large as Africa while holding about one fourteenth of its area.
detail: 1569年，佛拉芒制图师以把纬线间距按纬度拉伸的代价，让「恒向航线成直线」——为大洋导航而生。面积变形则留给后世：阿拉斯加「与巴西同大」、欧洲「与南美相仿」皆投影幻象；等积投影纠回面积时，形状又开始失真。
detailEn: In 1569 a Flemish mapmaker stretched parallel spacing by latitude so that constant-bearing routes ran straight — made for ocean navigation. The area cost came down the centuries: Alaska 'matching' Brazil, Europe 'matching' South America; equal-area projections restore the size only to set the shapes wobbling.

termEn: "You Can Swim and Dive Freely in the Dead Sea"
myth: 死海浮力大，所以游起来更轻松自由，潜水更不在话下。
mythEn: The Dead Sea's buoyancy makes swimming easier and diving a casual affair.
truth: 高盐使密度大增、漂浮确是被动而稳的；但常规泳姿失効，主动下潜几乎做不到，剧烈动作反会把人翻出水面。
truthEn: Brine so dense that passive floating comes free — yet ordinary strokes lose their grip, active diving is nearly impossible, and thrashing flips you up instead of down.
detail: 死海含盐度逾30%，浮力惊人，「躺漂读报」属实；但盐水入眼入口刺痛难当、对伤口有刺激，救生规范限制浸水时长与姿势。准确说法是：漂得起来，游不痛快。
detailEn: Salinity past 30% lets a reader float like a cork — true enough; but the brine scours eyes and mouth and irritates cuts, and lifeguard rules cap time in the water. The accurate claim: floating comes free, swimming does not.

termEn: "Time Zone Borders Run Straight Along Meridians"
myth: 全球被经线均匀切成24个时区，界线是笔直的南北线。
mythEn: The globe is cut evenly into 24 zones by meridians, each border a straight north-south line.
truth: 实际时区界线由各国法定，蜿蜒绕行于行政边界，时差也不都是整小时：尼泊尔用东5.75区，印度全境统一东5.5区。
truthEn: Real zone borders are set by law, wiggle around administrative lines, and the offsets need not be whole hours: Nepal keeps UTC+5:45, and one law gives all India UTC+5:30.
detail: 若严格按经线划线，同一座城市会被切成两个钟点：中国跨理论五个时区而通行一个统一时间，正是「经线归地理、时区归政治」的写照。地图上一格格的直边时区图，是罕见的美化。
detailEn: Cut strictly by meridians and a single city would split into two clocks: China spans five theoretical zones yet runs on one official time — meridians belong to geography, zones to politics. The neat striped time-zone map is a rare flattery.
